lines: You hear about what happened in maintenance, %OTHER_FIRST%?
Command's been quiet today. Never a good sign.
Is it me, or has the clown been unusually calm?

lines: I heard something. Didn't get the details.
Give it time. It never lasts.

dismiss.speaker: other
lines: I try not to ask. Makes the shift shorter.
I make a point of not knowing.
